item.title: Vegetation pile burns planned for Mt. Diablo State Park
item.description: Crews will conduct pile burns at Mount Diablo State Park sometime between January and March to reduce vegetation on the south side of the mountain, California State Parks officials announced Tuesday. The post Vegetation pile burns planned for Mt. Diablo State Park appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Dublin Councilmember McCorriston announces run for mayor this fall
item.description: Dublin City Councilmember Michael McCorriston announced this week his bid for mayor in November’s general election. The post Dublin Councilmember McCorriston announces run for mayor this fall appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: NNSA cancels public engagement efforts for increased plutonium use at LLNL
item.description: The Department of Energy’s National Nuclear Security Administration recently retracted its intention to publish a draft environmental report for public comment about increasing the amount of fissile material for research and development at Livermore’s national laboratory. The post NNSA cancels public engagement efforts for increased plutonium use at LLNL appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: EBRPD poised to bring retiree Doyle back as interim GM
item.description: The East Bay Regional Park District Board of Directors is set at Tuesday’s regular meeting to consider appointing retired general manager Robert Doyle to interim GM in the wake of Sabrina Landreth’s resignation from the role. The post EBRPD poised to bring retiree Doyle back as interim GM appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Guns, Fishing & Other Stuff closing in Dublin
item.description: One of the few places in the Tri-Valley to purchase guns, ammunition and shooting accessories – or even buy fishing equipment, for that matter – is shutting its doors in the coming weeks. The post Guns, Fishing & Other Stuff closing in Dublin appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Silicon Valley lawmaker could seek East Bay congressional seat
item.description: A state lawmaker representing parts of Santa Clara and Alameda counties might be angling for a congressional seat in the East Bay. Her candidacy would leave her own seat in the California Legislature up for grabs — if she decides to jump into the race. The post Silicon Valley lawmaker could seek East Bay congressional seat appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Meet Artemis at East Bay SPCA
item.description: A kind 3-year-old cat who loves a good game of hide-and-seek, Artemis from East Bay SPCA is quite the expert at investigating things and finding nice hiding locations. The post Meet Artemis at East Bay SPCA appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.
